question.question_text: Which took longer, the camera wearer's gardening activities including digging and planting or the subsequent cleaning and organizing in the kitchen?

answer_options.text: The camera wearer did not engage in gardening activities
Both activities had the same duration
There was no subsequent clwaning or organizing in the kitchen
Cleaning and organizing in the kitchen took longer

shared_investigation.established_facts: The camera wearer engaged in gardening activities including digging and planting, which spanned from 2160.0 to 2700.0 seconds. The subsequent cleaning and organizing in the kitchen occurred from 2700.0 to 3003.0 seconds. The gardening activities took longer as they spanned 540 seconds, while the kitchen cleaning spanned 303 seconds.

evidence_index.source_content: Outdoor gardening preparation: picks up plastic bag and bowl, walks to door and opens it, picks up plant from ground, digs soil with trowel, and pulls out weeds from soil.

Planting and soil work: digs soil with trowel while holding plant, scoops soil, places plastic bag on soil, pours powder from bowl on soil, places trowel on ground, picks up plastic bag, pours water on plants with watering can, picks up and drops plants on ground, and picks leaves from ground.

Return to indoor activities: picks up bowl and walks around house, washes plate with brush, walks around kitchen, washes bowl with sponge and rinses with water, puts bowl on sink, picks lettuce from bowl, washes vegetables, and walks around house picking up bottle from floor.
